levels.notes: R4's 'shop@4 + rest@7' route: the skilled level's fight numbers (bot-levels.json), shopping at the row-4 merchant (never healing there) and resting at the row-7 dojo (the base route prefers the dojo). Measures the R4 line of about 270 at the Tanuki directly (AM27 balance report, 2026-11-16).

A player's choice at the merchant: the skilled level's fight numbers, healing when under 50% health and shopping otherwise (R6), then resting at the row-7 dojo. The 50 is a proposed threshold for the designer (AM27 balance report, 2026-11-16).

notes: Route variants of the test bot, kept apart from bot-levels.json so its skill levels, '--level all' and the mixed batch stay as they are. Same format and loader (kind harness_bot_levels); run with '--levels data/harness/bot-routes.json --level <name>' or '--level all'. Each level overrides the base bot file; the fight numbers copy the skilled level of bot-levels.json and must be kept in step with it. Every value is proposed and uncalibrated (no playtests yet).
